description: This file contains mixins for button styles in SCSS, including variants for default, outline, and size configurations, designed to generate CSS custom properties for button theming.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Generates CSS custom properties for various button states (default, hover, active, disabled) based on input parameters for background, border, and color.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Sets CSS variables for outline-style buttons with specified color and interaction states like hover and active.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Defines padding, font size, and border-radius for button size variations, utilizing CSS custom properties.
